name.description:
The name of the TypeScript interface to generate. By default, the name of the type plus "Props" is used.
So a component named "Hello" gets "HelloProps".

ignoreMixins.description: Whether to suppress data fields of mixins (normally included).

ignorePrivate.description: Whether to skip private data fields of the type itself (normally included).

addImports.description: Whether to add imports of referenced types.

addExport.description: Whether to add export of the type.

outerIndentation.description: Indentation level (in spaces) of the interface declaration itself.

nullIfEmpty.description: If there are no data fields at all, return a null string (normally an empty interface).

title:
Details for generating the TypeScript declaration representing the data fields of a type.

@see ReactComponent#buildProps
